evaluation.decision: Each domain must pass both empirical point-value gates at the same calibration-only global threshold; no automatic winner
evaluation.threshold_rule: For each calibration domain allow floor(negative_count/1000) false positives; float64 nextafter of the next negative order statistic toward +infinity; global maximum; prediction is float64(logit)>=threshold

input.loss: Unweighted mean BCE plus fixed intervention rank_weight times ranking objective

partition.rule: Within domain sort by SHA256(canonical JSON [seed,domain,group_uid]); first 48 fit, remainder calibrate; outputs follow public input row order

ranking.objective: mean over 28 accounts of logsumexp(nonself logits) minus mean positive logit; all 378 unordered pairs scored once

interpretation: Each domain's fixed-threshold FPR<=0.001 AND recall>=0.5 is required. Point-value development qualification, not independent test, training-seed robustness, calibrated deployment guarantee, or automatic model selection. AP comparisons are secondary.
